Dear Larkspur team,

I am interested in hiring the Ashdown Eight for a film shoot. Our pick-up time would be 14 June 2027 at 9.30am and the drop-off time would be Wednesday 16 June 2027 at 17:30. Could you please have the vehicle waiting for us at Hotel Miramar Norvalle and collect it from there afterwards?

Cheers,
Hugo Wintermere
+70 756 337 3507
